title: AI Evaluation
lead: Pick journal entries that haven't been evaluated, from the same month (at most {n} at once). Rex judges your trading process, not the profit or loss. The result is saved and shows in the Journal. Each entry is evaluated only once.
signInTitle: Sign in to use AI Evaluation
signInBody: AI Evaluation reviews the journal of your Demo Account trades, so you need to sign in first.
emptyAllDone: Every journal entry of yours has been evaluated. The results are in the Journal.
emptyNoTrades: No Demo Account trade has closed yet. Every closed trade goes into the Journal and can then be evaluated here.
quotaNone: Today's evaluation limit has been reached. Available again from {time} WIB.
quotaUnknown: Today's remaining evaluations couldn't be read.
done: {n, plural, one {# entry was} other {# entries were}} evaluated and moved to the Journal.
otherMonth: Another month: clear your picks first to choose from this one
count: {n, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}} not evaluated
fillFirstLong: Some picks aren't complete: fill in the journal first (answer "followed the plan?" and write a note).
disclaimer: The evaluation is written by AI from your own trade data and journal. This is practice on historical data with virtual money, not investment advice or a trading signal.

errors.empty: Pick at least one journal entry.
errors.evaluated: An entry has already been evaluated. Each entry is evaluated only once.
errors.incomplete: Fill in the journal first: answer "followed the plan?" and write a note for every picked entry.
errors.mixedMonths: All entries must be from the same month.
errors.limit: Today's evaluation limit has been reached.
errors.aiFailed: Rex couldn't finish the evaluation. Nothing was saved and your quota wasn't used. Try again.
errors.aiBusy: Rex is busy. Nothing was saved and your quota wasn't used. Try again in a moment.
errors.unconfigured: AI Evaluation isn't switched on on the server yet.
errors.notReady: AI Evaluation is waiting for a database update. Try again later.
errors.saveFailed: The evaluation couldn't be saved. Nothing was saved. Try again.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Try again.
